description: Priority queue backed by bounded storage with push, pop, and peek bookkeeping atoms. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/priority_queue — verified priority queue'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/safe_queue.mm and std/contracts.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and std/contracts.mm already use.

atoms.name: pq_push
atoms.description: Bookkeeping step for inserting an item with a priority into a bounded priority queue.

atoms.name: pq_pop
atoms.description: Bookkeeping step for removing the highest-priority item from a non-empty priority queue.

atoms.name: pq_peek
atoms.description: Peek at a non-empty priority queue without changing its length.
